title: 冷钱包遭窃：1.8万枚比特币，长期反而利好？
speaker: Bloomberg

segments.en: Alex, you got me thinking about this sort of existential question about Bitcoin and whether it really goes at the narrative around this.
segments.zh: 亚历克斯，你让我思考关于比特币的生存问题，以及它是否真的符合这个叙事。

segments.en: You said at least in the short, medium term people are going to be reeling, but is there a long-term damage from this that turns people off to it?
segments.zh: 你说至少短期内人们会感到震惊，但长期来看，这件事是否会让人失去兴趣？

segments.en: You know, I think it's going to survive. Bitcoin has such a compelling story for those that believe in it.
segments.zh: 我认为它会存活下来。比特币对于相信它的人来说，有着如此引人入胜的故事。

segments.en: I actually think the long-term impact will largely be positive.
segments.zh: 实际上，我认为长期影响在很大程度上将是积极的。

segments.en: You have developers coming across from, coming together from across the ecosystem, utilizing the most modern AI technologies to red team Bitcoin, open source software at scale.
segments.zh: 开发者们从生态系统中汇聚一堂，利用最现代的AI技术，大规模地对比特币开源软件进行红队测试。

segments.en: I think some lessons have been learned here about, you know, Bitcoiners like to say often don't trust, verify.
segments.zh: 我认为这里已经吸取了一些教训，比特币爱好者常说：不要信任，要验证。

segments.en: I think it's very clear that not enough verification was being done, and that's being forcefully corrected here at scale.
segments.zh: 很明显，之前验证做得不够，而现在正在大规模地强力纠正这一点。

segments.en: So I think you'll get better education out of Bitcoin influencers about how to self-custody safely.
segments.zh: 所以，我认为比特币影响者会提供更好的教育，教人们如何安全地自我托管。

segments.en: I think you'll see Bitcoin community be less judgmental against those who choose not to self-custody, and they won't be derided as not being pure enough in the Bitcoin philosophy.
segments.zh: 我认为比特币社区会减少对选择不自我托管的人的评判，他们不会因为不够纯粹而被嘲笑。

segments.en: And I think you'll see a substantially increased amount of money and effort spent to evaluate code bases for vulnerabilities.
segments.zh: 而且，我认为会有更多的资金和精力投入到评估代码库的漏洞上。
